build_dictionary_from_corpus: build a language dictionary from TalkTheWalk training, validation, and test JSON datasets
encode_text_with_dictionary: encode a text message into token IDs using the Dictionary class with TweetTokenizer
decode_tokens_to_text: decode a list of token IDs back into human readable text using Dictionary
